value.body: An air cargo executive handles goods that travel by air — from medicines and electronics to e-commerce parcels. Employers are freight forwarders, airline cargo departments, cargo-terminal operators and courier companies. The day involves preparing air waybills, booking space on flights, coordinating customs clearance and tracking shipments.

items.label: Typical entry
items.note: Short courses in air cargo or freight forwarding are common add-ons

items.label: Key documents
items.value: Air waybill, commercial invoice, packing list, shipping bill

items.label: Workplace
items.value: Forwarder offices and airport cargo terminals

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Freshers usually start as documentation or operations executives at freight-forwarding or courier companies, or as cargo assistants with airlines and terminal operators. Knowledge of export-import paperwork helps in interviews.

value.title: At a glance
items: Common next roles: cargo supervisor, key-account executive, logistics manager.
The skills carry over to sea freight and wider logistics roles.
Terminal roles involve shifts; forwarder roles have deadline-driven days.
